crossRefs.note: In the four hundred and eightieth year after the children of Israel had come out of the land of Egypt, in the fourth…
He began to build in the second day of the second month, in the fourth year of his reign.

translations.web: The foundation of Yahweh’s house was laid in the fourth year, in the month Ziv.
translations.bsb: The foundation of the house of the LORD was laid in the fourth year of Solomon’s reign, in the month of Ziv.
translations.kjv: In the fourth year was the foundation ➔ of the house of the LORD laid, in the month Zif:
translations.asv: In the fourth year was the foundation of the house of Jehovah laid, in the month Ziv.
